properties.finding: no training on Customer Content under the Commercial Terms; commercial API inputs and outputs not used for training by default; feedback submitted by a user is an exception

API inputs and outputs deleted on the backend within 30 days, EXCEPT: longer-retention services under customer control (Files API), a separate agreement (ZDR), Usage Policy enforcement, and legal compliance. E7 states content is not retained by default except for Covered Models; E2 states 30 days. The stricter reading, 30 days plus the exceptions, is bound.
flagged content: inputs and outputs up to 2 years, classification scores up to 7 years, applicable even under ZDR
exists per organization by arrangement; whether the operator's organization has it is NOT_ESTABLISHED and cannot be established from documentation
Fable 5.1, Mythos 5.1, Fable 5 and Mythos 5 require 30-day retention; claude-sonnet-5 is not a Covered Model
prompts and outputs are not stored by the structured-output feature; the JSON schema is cached up to 24 hours

errors are JSON with a type and message; the documented examples echo no input. Whether a validation error can echo submitted content, and any provider-side diagnostic logging beyond the retention rules, are NOT_ESTABLISHED. Silence is not permission: the client must treat error bodies as possibly containing source text.
inference geo and workspace geo control where processing and storage happen; neither changes retention
commercial pages scope themselves to the API and Claude for Work; the consumer subscription route remains a different, NOT_APPROVED route
claude-sonnet-5 listed as active; not a Covered Model

source_condition_check.documented_bounded_retention: SATISFIED_WITH_EXCEPTIONS (30 days; flagged content up to 2 years; legal retention) — bound in the packet, not assumed away
source_condition_check.inference_only: BOUND IN PACKET (no batch, files, feedback, console use)

conditions_the_packet_must_bind: model claude-sonnet-5, not a Covered Model; no Fable or Mythos model
synchronous POST /v1/messages only: no batch, Files API, MCP connector, web search, code execution, prompt caching or cache_control
no Console or playground use with Stack Overflow text
retention bound recorded as 30 days plus the four documented exceptions; flagged content up to 2 years; ZDR not assumed
the strict tool schema contains no Stack Overflow text
no feedback or bug reports containing request content
provider error bodies are treated as possibly containing source text: only request_id, error type, HTTP status and a sha256 of the body may be logged or recorded
execution falls inside the review window of this requalification (180 days from 2026-09-16) or the evidence is retrieved again
not_established: whether a 400 error can echo submitted content
provider-side diagnostic logging beyond the documented retention rules
whether the operator organization holds a ZDR arrangement
